'''Yezo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war he was stationed in [[Outpost Zerek]] on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] to others from a stall. Yezo wore a [[Color/Legends|white]], blue and brown [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and made use of a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] while at his stall. He had tanned skin, orange [[Eye/Legends|eye]] and brown hair.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yezo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he served as a Republic stims vendor on Hoth. His location was also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', [[Prima Games]] strategy guide for ''The Old Republic''.
